display_long_description:
🧟 The apocalypse has begun… and the clock is ticking 🧟

💥 Step into a fast-paced VR arcade zombie shooter built for pure adrenaline! Fight through relentless waves of the undead using dual-wield weapons, lightning-fast reflexes, and smart positioning to survive as long as possible 💥

⏱️ Every match is a race against time. The clock is always running out, and the only way to stay alive is to eliminate zombies to gain precious extra seconds. The longer you survive, the more chaotic and dangerous the battlefield becomes ⏱️

🧠 Face multiple types of enemies, each with unique behaviors that constantly challenge your strategy. Adapt quickly, react fast, and stay focused as the pressure keeps rising 🧠

🌍 Battle across several unique maps, each with its own atmosphere and challenges. Earn money by defeating zombies and unlock new locations as you push deeper into the apocalypse 🌍

🚁 Unleash powerful random power-ups and call in military support including air strikes, attack helicopters, and robotic turrets to turn the tide when the horde becomes overwhelming 🚁

🧩 Uncover a gripping hidden story as you play, piecing together cryptic transmissions, classified documents, and buried secrets that reveal the truth behind the apocalypse 🧩

🔥 With escalating waves, intense VR gunplay, and nonstop arcade action, survival is never guaranteed 🔥

💀 Shoot fast. Think faster. Survive the apocalypse 💀
